term: accessible population subintersection and exact meet closure
definition: AbsenceAmalgamation F present w requires for every ordered pair u,v accessible from w a z accessible from w whose present extension is contained in both. ExactMeetClosure instead requires pointwise equivalence with membership in both extensions. Both quantify over a fixed roster; neither requires any accessible world or any present individual. They are vacuous without an accessible pair. Exact equality of populations is distinct from identity of worlds; different worlds can have the same extension.
note: Common API for #533/#534, introduced by #607. These mathematical policies supply no evidence that their resulting profiles are metaphysically possible. No frame restriction or existence-to-concreteness bridge is included.
